entrypoints.summary: A syzkaller program creates a UNIX socketpair, sends an ancillary-control blob, closes the sending endpoint, and invokes nonblocking recvmsg on the peer.
The issue-specific C reproducer invokes recvmsg with MSG_DONTWAIT on the socketpair endpoint.

affected_components.role: Failed ancillary-control externalization recovery and control-data restoration.

code_slices.fixed: The patch replaces that assertion with a conditional covering SBS_CANTRCVMORE and control-data restoration exceeding sb_hiwat, then unlocks and returns the externalization error.
code_slices.surrounding_context: The patch comment identifies the intervening unlocked period while unp_externalize() fails and identifies disconnect and buffer filling as unhandleable edge conditions.
code_slices.vulnerable: The pre-fix recovery path reacquired SOCK_RECVBUF_LOCK and executed MPASS(!(sb->sb_state & SBS_CANTRCVMORE)) before the existing capacity check.

negative_controls: Fixed guard handles a closed receive side by returning an error rather than reaching the assertion.
No run result for the bundled reproducer is included.

sources.concept: UNIX-domain socket peer ancillary-control input and disconnect

impact.attacker_capability: A local process able to use UNIX-domain sockets and invoke the reproduced socket operations can trigger the erroneous recovery path on an affected kernel.
impact.security_effect: Kernel availability loss through assertion panic

causal_trace.summary: A local UNIX-domain socket peer sends an ancillary-control blob, closes its endpoint, and the receiving endpoint executes recvmsg.

During a failing unp_externalize() operation the receive-buffer lock is dropped, allowing the peer to disconnect or the buffer to become too full to prepend the control data back before the lock is reacquired.
The pre-fix receive path asserted that SBS_CANTRCVMORE was clear after reacquiring the receive-buffer lock, rather than treating a closed receive side as a recovery error condition.
The assertion fires in uipc_soreceive_stream_or_seqpacket on the recvmsg path, causing a FreeBSD kernel panic.

failure.operation: MPASS assertion checking that SBS_CANTRCVMORE is clear in uipc_soreceive_stream_or_seqpacket

primary_invariant.statement: After failed control externalization, control data may be restored to the receive buffer only while the receive side remains open and the buffer has capacity for the prepend.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The lock-drop interval around failing externalization permits peer disconnect or receive-buffer filling, while the old recovery path assumed the receive-closed flag was still clear.

quality.review_notes: The issue record reports the observed assertion panic and supplies issue-specific C and syzkaller reproducers, while the maintainer patch directly documents the lock-drop recovery window and remediation. The provided syzkaller sequence demonstrates the disconnect pattern; the patch also documents buffer filling as a separate possible interleaving, but this record does not claim that the supplied reproducer demonstrates that branch. No execution of either reproducer against a particular build is present in this bundle.

remediation.invariant_restored: On return from failed externalization, a closed receive side or insufficient buffer capacity prevents control-data restoration; the path unlocks and returns the externalization error instead of asserting.

state_context.attacker_state_setup: Create a UNIX socketpair, submit ancillary control data, close the sending peer, then receive on the other endpoint.
data_structure_invariants: SBS_CANTRCVMORE must remain clear before restoration is attempted.
Control-data restoration length plus existing control accounting must not exceed the receive-buffer high-water mark.
state_context.state_machine: Control externalization failure releases the receive-buffer lock; recovery later reacquires it and attempts to restore control data.

oracle.expected_negative: On the fixed path, a closed receive side or insufficient receive-buffer space after failed externalization is handled by unlock-and-error return rather than this assertion.
oracle.expected_positive: On the affected pre-fix build, the issue oracle is an assertion panic stating that SBS_CANTRCVMORE must be clear, with a recvmsg-to-uipc_soreceive_stream_or_seqpacket stack path.
